name: Tom Aspinall
bio: Tom Aspinall is the UFC Heavyweight Champion, a rare combination of elite grappling and explosive striking who has finished every title fight opponent in the first round. After capturing the interim belt at UFC 295 with a 27-second TKO of Sergei Pavlovich, Aspinall became undisputed champion in 2025. The Manchester native is widely regarded as the most well-rounded heavyweight in UFC history.

name: Curtis Blaydes
bio: Curtis Blaydes is one of the top heavyweight grapplers in the world, using his Division I wrestling background to suffocate opponents with relentless top pressure and ground-and-pound. A former title challenger, he has defeated multiple top-ten heavyweights. Blaydes recently rebounded from a first-round TKO loss to Aspinall to remain the division's top contender.

name: Sergei Pavlovich
bio: Sergei Pavlovich is a devastating knockout artist who ran off nine first-round finishes before his title shot at UFC 295. The Russian powerhouse owns the fastest-ever KO in heavyweight history and has finished most of his opponents inside one round. His surgical straight right hand makes him one of the most feared strikers in the heavyweight division.

name: Ciryl Gane
bio: Ciryl Gane is the most technical heavyweight in MMA history, combining kickboxing precision with extraordinary athletic movement that belies his 250-pound frame. An interim champion and two-time title challenger, Bon Gamin has losses only to Ngannou and Aspinall — both undisputed champions. His footwork and combination striking are elite at any weight class.

name: Jailton Almeida
bio: Jailton Almeida is a submission grappling specialist who brings BJJ black belt technique to the heavyweight division with a 90% finish rate. The Brazilian has 17 submission victories and consistently drags big heavyweights to the mat where they are helpless. His rapid rise through the UFC ranks marks him as a genuine future title threat.

name: Alex Pereira
bio: Alex Pereira is one of the most exciting champions in UFC history, having captured belts in two weight classes. A former Glory Kickboxing world champion, Poatan's power is considered generational — he has five first-round knockouts in his last seven UFC fights. His willingness to take short notice fights and face all comers has made him the face of the sport.

name: Magomed Ankalaev
bio: Magomed Ankalaev is one of the most underrated fighters on the roster, a technically precise striker with world-class wrestling who has steamrolled through the light heavyweight division. His lone non-win is a controversial split draw against Jan Blachowicz. With seven straight victories, Ankalaev is the division's most credible title challenger.

name: Jiří Procházka
bio: Jiří Procházka is the most unconventional fighter in the UFC, combining samurai philosophy with unpredictable wild striking that has produced some of the most memorable finishes in light heavyweight history. A former champion who submitted Glover Teixeira to win the title, Procházka fights without fear and has never turned down a bout.

name: Khalil Rountree Jr.
bio: Khalil Rountree Jr. is one of the most improved fighters in the UFC, transforming from a prospect into a legitimate title challenger through relentless work ethic. He went on a stunning six-fight knockout streak before earning a shot at Alex Pereira at UFC 307. His powerful and creative striking style makes him dangerous against anyone in the division.

name: Dricus du Plessis
bio: Dricus du Plessis made history as the first South African UFC champion, stopping two all-time greats in Israel Adesanya and Sean Strickland to prove he belongs among the elite. His relentless forward pressure and ability to take punishment while remaining dangerous makes him one of the toughest fighters on the roster. Du Plessis is now cementing his legacy with defences against the division's best.

name: Robert Whittaker
bio: Robert Whittaker is a former UFC Middleweight Champion and one of the most technically gifted strikers in the division's history. With crisp combinations, elite footwork, and iron chin, The Reaper has beaten nearly every top contender. His rivalry with Israel Adesanya defined an era of middleweight competition, and he remains the division's top challenger.

name: Khamzat Chimaev
bio: Khamzat Chimaev is the UFC's most dominant undefeated prospect-turned-contender, overwhelming opponents with elite wrestling, smothering grappling, and powerful striking. Borz has not yet been taken to a decision by a UFC opponent who wasn't at the absolute top of the sport. His unbeaten record and willingness to fight anyone make him the division's most feared threat.

name: Sean Strickland
bio: Sean Strickland is one of MMA's most polarizing and unpredictable champions, pulling off one of the biggest upsets in UFC history when he dominated Israel Adesanya for the middleweight title. His boxing-first style prioritizes volume and pressure over power, and his ability to ignore damage while landing clean punches makes him uniquely difficult to fight.

name: Israel Adesanya
bio: Israel Adesanya is a generational striking talent and three-time UFC Middleweight Champion whose anime-influenced style and culture-shifting presence made him one of the most iconic figures in combat sports. A kickboxing world champion turned MMA superstar, Izzy's footwork and counter-striking are among the most technically sophisticated ever seen in the UFC.

name: Belal Muhammad
bio: Belal Muhammad is the UFC Welterweight Champion, a relentless wrestler and pressure fighter who stole the belt from Leon Edwards with an unstoppable performance at UFC 304. Known for his suffocating top control and constant forward pressure, Muhammad has wins over multiple top-five welterweights and continues to improve with each fight.

name: Jack Della Maddalena
bio: Jack Della Maddalena is the most exciting welterweight prospect in years, a powerful puncher with elite timing and finishing instinct who has stopped seven of his eight UFC opponents. JDM's rise through the division has been meteoric — he turned down a walkout fight offer to land his spot as the number one contender. At just 28, he looks destined for gold.

name: Shavkat Rakhmonov
bio: Shavkat Rakhmonov is one of the last undefeated elite fighters in the UFC, combining Sambist grappling with diverse striking to finish all eighteen of his professional opponents. The Kazakh Nomad's blend of creativity and raw power makes him dangerous everywhere, and a title shot feels inevitable after demolishing Vicente Luque and Ian Machado Garry.

name: Leon Edwards
bio: Leon Edwards is a former UFC Welterweight Champion who delivered one of the most dramatic moments in MMA history — a walk-off head kick KO in the fifth round at UFC 278 to become champion. Rocky's clean boxing and disciplined gameplan made him a two-time champion, and he is rebuilding for another title run following his loss to Belal Muhammad.

name: Islam Makhachev
bio: Islam Makhachev is the UFC Lightweight Champion and pound-for-pound number one fighter in the world, an elite Dagestani wrestler whose top control and submission threat make him nearly impossible to beat. Trained by Khabib Nurmagomedov, Makhachev has successfully defended his title against Volkanovski twice and Dustin Poirier, cementing his status as the division's dominant force.

name: Arman Tsarukyan
bio: Arman Tsarukyan is the most complete lightweight challenger in recent memory, combining world-class wrestling with powerful boxing that earned him a title shot at UFC 311. Although he fell short against Makhachev, his exceptional performance — going the distance and rocking the champion — confirmed his elite status. At 28, another title shot is all but guaranteed.

name: Charles Oliveira
bio: Charles Oliveira is the all-time UFC record holder for most finishes and most submission victories, a late-bloomer who found his elite form after years of promise to become a two-time title contender. Do Bronx's resilience is legendary — he has been finished or hurt badly and come back to win multiple times. His BJJ and submission game remain world-class.

name: Justin Gaethje
bio: Justin Gaethje is the embodiment of action-packed MMA, a relentless pressure fighter whose willingness to trade with anyone has produced some of the most memorable lightweight battles in UFC history. A former interim champion and BMF title holder, The Highlight always moves forward and has earned Fight of the Night bonuses in almost every appearance.

name: Max Holloway
bio: Max Holloway is one of the greatest featherweights in UFC history and a former three-time champion, a tireless volume striker who threw the most punches in the final round in UFC history against Gaethje at UFC 300. Blessed combines elite cardio, high fight IQ and an ever-evolving technical game into one of the most complete packages in combat sports.

name: Ilia Topuria
bio: Ilia Topuria is the UFC Featherweight Champion and one of the most explosive knockout artists in the sport, the first Georgian-born fighter to become a UFC champion. El Matador dethroned the greatest featherweight of all time in Alexander Volkanovski and followed it by stopping Max Holloway, cementing his status as the new face of the 145-pound division at just 27.

name: Alexander Volkanovski
bio: Alexander Volkanovski was the longest-reigning UFC Featherweight Champion in history at three years, a former rugby player who built himself into a three-time champion through sheer work rate and technical improvement. Despite losing to Topuria and Makhachev, The Great's legacy as arguably the most complete featherweight champion ever is secure.

name: Movsar Evloev
bio: Movsar Evloev is one of the UFC's most underrated unbeaten fighters, a complete mixed martial artist from Ingushetia, Russia who uses precise wrestling and clean technical striking to control fights from start to finish. His consistency and efficiency have made him the featherweight division's most dangerous under-the-radar contender.

name: Merab Dvalishvili
bio: Merab Dvalishvili is the UFC Bantamweight Champion and the most relentless wrestler in the division, recording an average of ten takedown attempts per fight with non-stop cardio that breaks every opponent he faces. The Machine's victory over Sean O'Malley at UFC 306 was one of the year's most dominant title-winning performances.

name: Petr Yan
bio: Petr Yan is a former UFC Bantamweight Champion and one of the most technically polished strikers in the division's history, with elite boxing technique and relentless pressure that have made him champion and perennial contender. No Mercy has shared the cage with every elite bantamweight of the last five years and remains one of the most dangerous fighters at 135.

name: Cory Sandhagen
bio: Cory Sandhagen is one of the most creative strikers in the UFC, a lanky bantamweight whose long reach and unorthodox attack angles produce spectacular knockouts. The Sandman's spinning techniques and flying knees are matched by a strong wrestling base that makes him dangerous in all phases. He consistently ranks among the best 135-pound fighters in the world.

name: Umar Nurmagomedov
bio: Umar Nurmagomedov is the most dominant undefeated prospect at bantamweight, combining his cousin Khabib's suffocating wrestling with sharper boxing and submission skills. The Dagestani powerhouse has dominated every opponent and recently defeated Cory Sandhagen in a performance that showed he's ready to challenge for the title.

name: Alexandre Pantoja
bio: Alexandre Pantoja is the UFC Flyweight Champion and one of the most active BJJ practitioners in the division, constantly threatening submissions from any position. The Cannibal has successfully unified the title and made multiple defences, beating Brandon Moreno twice in the process. His relentless submission hunting and world-class wrestling make him the complete flyweight package.

name: Brandon Moreno
bio: Brandon Moreno is a former UFC Flyweight Champion and one of the most beloved fighters in the sport, a high-octane fan favourite from Tijuana who won the title by submitting Deiveson Figueiredo in one of the most anticipated rematches in UFC history. Moreno and Pantoja's rivalry has defined the flyweight division of the 2020s.

name: Valentina Shevchenko
bio: Valentina Shevchenko is one of the greatest female fighters in MMA history, a seven-time UFC Women's Flyweight Champion whose technical mastery, elite striking and championship composure make her the gold standard for women's combat sports. The Bullet has defeated eight former or future champions during her reign and remains the greatest fighter the division has ever seen.

name: Alexa Grasso
bio: Alexa Grasso is a former UFC Women's Flyweight Champion who became a national hero in Mexico when she submitted Valentina Shevchenko at UFC 285 to win the belt. Tigresa's slick striking and underrated grappling make her a genuine threat to any champion, and her rivalry with Shevchenko has been the defining narrative in women's flyweight MMA.

name: Zhang Weili
bio: Zhang Weili is a two-time UFC Women's Strawweight Champion and China's biggest MMA superstar, a relentless pressure fighter with elite wrestling, powerful striking and an iron will that allows her to overcome any adversity. Magnum has fought the best in the world and currently holds the longest active title reign in the women's strawweight division.

name: Rose Namajunas
bio: Rose Namajunas is a two-time UFC Women's Strawweight Champion and one of the most technically gifted strikers in women's MMA, a patient counterpuncher with explosive power who has twice knocked out Joanna Jędrzejczyk. Thug Rose's cerebral approach and fight IQ give her the ability to dismantle any opponent on a given night.

name: Raquel Pennington
bio: Raquel Pennington is the UFC Women's Bantamweight Champion, finally achieving championship gold after over a decade of competing at the elite level. Rocky is a durable, well-rounded fighter whose heart and resilience have been on display in some of the division's toughest fights. Her championship victory was the culmination of years of perseverance in one of MMA's deepest divisions.

name: Julianna Peña
bio: Julianna Peña is a former UFC Women's Bantamweight Champion who pulled off one of the greatest upsets in UFC history when she submitted Amanda Nunes at UFC 269. A relentless grappler with elite submission game and a cast-iron will, The Venezuelan Vixen is always dangerous and brings intensity and aggression that has made her one of the division's most exciting fighters.
